attributes.probed_form:
FIVE KEEPS, each committed separately, each arbitrated on a fresh full-ninja fuzzy.

KEEP 1 (b218f61d4, fuzzy 87.5834 -> 88.8695, real 446 -> 429, multiset 6t -> 5t). The `(m->flags & 8)` prompt block gained `pc = "Center";` as its first statement and its three `"Center"` literals became `pc`. Target hoists the string address once (`li r23,0 @lbl_803475F4`) and spends `addi r7,r23,0` twice plus `mr r3,r23`; we were rematerialising `li rX,0 @@926` three times. This ONE mechanism was the ENTIRE `+2 addi` half of the multiset - after the keep the addi delta is exactly zero. The sibling `(m->flags & 2)` block already had this shape (`pc = ternary`), which is what made the diagnosis certain: same idiom, same block family, one arm written without the variable.

KEEP 2 (ad502e883, fuzzy 88.8695 -> 88.9247, real 429 -> 395). `idx = px;` moved from the LAST statement of the `(m->flags & 1)` block to its FIRST, and the block's four `px` uses became `idx`. Target emits `addi r30,r24,0` inside the block at +0x9b0; we emitted `mr r30,r26` AFTER it at +0xa3c and used r26 throughout.

KEEP 3 (also ad502e883, arbitrated CONFLICT). `s32 w1 = DrawNormalText(...); s32 w2 = DrawNormalText(...); x = m->x + w1 + w2;` became `x = m->x + DrawNormalText(...); x = x + DrawNormalText(...);`. Splitting the accumulation across the two calls removed the `mr r22,r3` that carried w1 across the second call. probe.py said CONFLICT (real 395 -> 424) but multiset 5t -> 4t, count distance 3 -> 2, and the aligned read showed the region converge to register-identical with only the pervasive lfs schedule swap left; fresh fuzzy 88.9247 -> 89.1832 confirmed the keep.

KEEP 4 (966aa4500, fuzzy 89.1832 -> 89.8432, insns 799 -> 798, multiset 4t -> 3t, real 424 -> 435). The prompt block's `u32 rgbp;` DECLARATION WAS DELETED and its five uses respelled to the function-scope `u32 color`, which the item loop above has already assigned. This is the MB law executed literally: `rgbp` was the first assignment in its own block scope and therefore paid a surplus `mr r25,r0`; `color` is not, and the copy vanished. defake_gate FAILED on `real` here with no sibling regression and was overridden on fresh fuzzy plus count distance 2 -> 1 and multiset 4t -> 3t; the gate baseline was then re-taken and showed 23 of 27 functions still at real 0, unchanged from the pass-start baseline.

KEEP 5 (ec23d8983, THE COUNT CLOSURE: insns 798 -> 797 = EQUAL, multiset 3t -> 2t, real 435 -> 382). The title block's inline three-term colour expression became `color = <expr>; txt = DrawTextKeepScale(..., color, m->title);`. Same law again, one level up: `color`'s first in-scope assignment had migrated to the item loop after keep 4, so the surplus `addi r24,r4,0` moved there; giving `color` an earlier definition at the title site - where the value is consumed straight into an argument register and coalesces for free - removed the copy WITHOUT introducing one at the new site. The aligned read confirms the title site builds directly into r6 exactly as the target does, and the cluster count fell 66 -> 60. Fuzzy 89.8432 -> 89.6236 (-0.22) against real -53, count distance 1 -> 0 and multiset 3t -> 2t; kept, and keep 6 recovered the fuzzy.

KEEP 6 (also ec23d8983 / e7f820d71, parity-held). Inside `if (t == 0)`, the two statements of `if (ty != m->icon_y) { m->icon_t = 1; ty = m->icon_y; }` were swapped to `{ ty = m->icon_y; m->icon_t = 1; }`. This cured the `lwz r7,212(r31)` re-load into the target's `mr r7,r3`: with no store between the two reads MWCC keeps the CSE. real 388 -> 382, counts held 797/797, fuzzy 89.6236 -> 89.7993.

KEEP 7 (e7f820d71, parity-held). `hi2 = hifont;` and `itemfont = font2;` swapped positions in the loop head. This flipped the COPY FORM of both: `addi r26,r29,0` now matches the target byte-for-byte and the copy-form half of the residual is cured. real 382 -> 380, counts held, fuzzy 89.7993 -> 89.8118.

THREE MEASURED NEGATIVES, all reverted, recorded so they are not respent.
NEGATIVE 1, NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL (object bytes unchanged): swapping the declaration order of `s32 savedFlags;` and `volatile s32 lh;`. slotdiff measures savedFlags and lh SWAPPED between stack slots 88 and 96 (target savedFlags@88 lh@96; ours the reverse) with all 20 slots otherwise aligned and the frame equal at 216. Declaration order does NOT drive this assignment - the edit folded away before codegen, which per probe.py is a stronger negative than a regression. The slot-order law family is therefore REFUTED for this pair and the 88/96 swap remains an open, unexplained spill-ordering fact.
NEGATIVE 2, reverted: `s32 iy = m->icon_y;` hoisted as an explicit temp inside `if (t == 0)`. It BROKE count parity (797 -> 798) and the multiset (2t -> 3t) for only -1 real. The statement-order form (keep 6) is the correct carrier of the same CSE; the explicit temp is not.
NEGATIVE 3, NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL: swapping the declaration order of `s32 hi2;` and `s32 itemfont;`. Declaration order is null here; the ASSIGNMENT order (keep 7) is the live lever. Together with negative 1 this is two independent NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL results on declaration order in one function - treat decl-order as a dead axis for show_optmenu and reach for assignment order or scope width instead.
attributes.residual:
BASELINE 87.5834% fuzzy, real 446, insns T797/O799, multiset 6t, 71 ops clusters. BEST 89.8118% fuzzy, real 380, insns T797/O797 EQUAL, multiset 2t, 59 ops clusters. Net +2.228 fuzzy on a 3188-byte function; show_optmenu's (1-fuzzy)*size impact fell from ~396 to ~325.

RECLASSIFICATION, which is the deliverable that outlives the fuzzy number. attempt.HB_show-optmenu-count-delta-bars-the-postprocessor-path.20260901.v1 correctly identified the two-instruction count delta as a hard, pre-existing ineligibility for EVERY WebFrank stage, and reclassified the function to source-class on that basis. That bar is now GONE: the counts are 797/797. The function re-enters the equal-size census population it was excluded from. NOTE FOR THE NEXT LANE, and the reason this matters: HB's record states the direction backwards - it says 'two instructions are MISSING from our stream' when fndiff reports OURS longer by 2, which is the opposite. The cure was to REMOVE two of our instructions (two surplus register copies), not to supply two missing ones. A lane that trusted HB's direction would have hunted for unwritten code that does not exist.

REMAINING RESIDUAL, one named mechanism plus one token pair. (1) THE DOMINANT ROW COST IS ONE SCHEDULE MECHANISM REPEATED ~15 TIMES: at essentially every DrawTextKeepScale/DrawNormalText call site the target emits the FP argument load LAST (immediately before the `bl`, after the integer argument setup) while we emit it FIRST, at the top of the basic block. It is count-neutral and byte-for-byte a two-position rotation of {lfs, lwz/mr}. It is consistent in 15 of 15 sites on both sides, so it is deterministic rather than noise, but no source lever was found and none is obvious: the FP value is argument 1, so source order predicts OUR placement, not the target's. With counts now equal this is precisely the instruction_permutation class. (2) The 2-token multiset (target-only +1 li, ours-only -1 mr) is a single displaced word, not a form error: at +0x260 the local window's opcodes agree exactly and only the position of `mr r23,r16` differs.

NEXT LANE, CONCRETE: show_optmenu is now an equal-size, 2-token, schedule-dominated candidate and should be screened by the WebFrank lane for instruction_permutation, which was structurally impossible before this pass. Source-side, the untried direction is the FP-argument-load placement as a single population - census it image-wide before probing it per function, because 15 sites in one function almost certainly means a large image-wide population with one shared cause.
